reviews.text: They were my trusted vets, but over time they've proven superficial and out of date, especially the older ones (only Rovati stands out). I have nothing to say about the younger ones, however; they've generally always been good.

I would like to sincerely thank Dr. Carola Colombo of the Veterinary Clinic on Via Sanbuco for the professionalism, expertise, and great kindness she showed during my cat's visit.
From the very first moment, she was very attentive and helpful, taking the time to clearly and understandably explain my cat's condition and the treatment plan. Her empathy and ability to reassure both the animal and the owner truly make a difference.
It's rare to find professionals so well-prepared and so human at the same time. Thank you so much for the assistance and care she provided. Highly recommended!
🐱❤️🙏

A new experience began for me today...I've known the facility since August 25th. The facility and staff are excellent. A true "hospital" for four-legged friends.

Amazing veterinary Clinic. My dog had a spike inside his paw, spent  two weeks going back and forth with other vets  and they were not able to diagnose him properly. The doctor in clínica sambuco knew what was going on as soon as he saw him. 30 mins later, he had pulled the spike of. The experience they have in this hospital is beyond words. Could not recommend them enough.

First experience, on the recommendation of a dear friend, I brought
my cat today and finally felt I could completely trust Dr. Rovati's expertise (but I'm sure the entire team is at the same level).
Kind and sweet with my Enea, but confident, competent, clear, thorough, and available—I think you couldn't ask for more than this for our life companions and for us companions.
The secretary was delightful, the atmosphere was calm, professional, but I can't tell you...there was an air of true and serious passion for animals.
And great respect for us humans.
I'm also writing this review to give hope to those who believe that real veterinarians no longer exist. Today I finally met one who can still express himself without responding to the commercial dynamics that are destroying families and animals.
Thank you, thank you, and thank you again!
always exceptional

A cat with chronic diarrhea... no diagnostic hypothesis or differential diagnosis... just symptomatic treatment and the response, "There's nothing else we can do" when we called to say she wasn't improving. An abdominal ultrasound cost €150 with a report (if you can call it that) with no images and just a few sentences... only to find out that certain intestinal lesions hadn't even been identified. This, to me, is unprofessional, I'm sorry.

Good morning, as always, I wanted to highlight the great professionalism and accuracy in the work carried out by Dr. Roberta Bonalumi in solving a problem that affected my dog. I want to underline that the skill of this doctor is indisputable and that she does everything for the good of our pets without giving up.... so well done Roberta #1😊

Dear Franco Z., thank you for taking the time to leave a review of our veterinary practice. Have a wonderful day.

The rudeness of the blonde secretary
⭐☆☆☆ ☆

The clinic definitely deserves five stars for the professionalism of the veterinarians. Unfortunately, however, there's one detail that manages to ruin the experience: the receptionist's management.

After hours of trying to call, always receiving call forwarding, I went to the clinic in person. The secretary, true to her usual Monday morning mood, found me an appointment with no problem. However, when I pointed out that the phone seemed unreachable, she replied with absolute certainty that there was nothing wrong with the service and that they were simply "overloaded with calls."

At that point, I decided to do a little practical demonstration: I called the number in front of her. Call forwarding appeared on my phone once again. And then, magic happened: without saying a word, the secretary immediately deactivated the forwarding and the reception phone started ringing. A technological miracle, real-time.

It's truly a shame that a facility with competent and professional veterinarians is penalized by the attitude of a single individual: brusque manners, lack of courtesy, and questionable communication management end up creating inconvenience not only for clients, but also for the animals who need prompt assistance.

A word of advice: next time, instead of denying the obvious, perhaps a little transparency and a smile would be enough. They would certainly have more impact than a call forwarding that suddenly disappeared.

I'll bring my dog ​​again. The good, efficient vets solved the problem with expertise and kindness.

Professionalism, kindness, honesty. Have you ever seen a vet who sits on the floor when your dog comes in to make contact? This is Dr. Rovati, my vet for years.
Thank you for sharing your experience and for your trust in us! We work passionately to ensure quality care and attention for all the pets who trust us.
Your kind words truly make us happy! Our team works hard every day to provide attentive and professional service. Knowing that you appreciate our work is the best reward. Thank you for your trust!
Dr. Rovati is a true veterinarian, meticulous, very understanding, and clear in his explanations. We finally found the doctor we were looking for for our dogs.

BEST CLINIC I'VE EVER SEEN IN MY LIFE.
I entrusted myself to this clinic, specifically to DOCTOR ZIBELLINI, the best person who truly loves animals. I brought my sick dog, specifically with IBD, a rare and very serious disease. He was able (in a situation where little Vittoria, underweight with little hope, is a very rare disease) to reassure us, to dedicate time to us, to explain, to avoid making us spend more money, and to take advantage of the tests that had already been done on her, but above all, to not discourage us, because we would have arrived at a glimmer of light.
I waited a month and two weeks before writing, because after the dog (French Bull Dog) had weighed 7.3 kg, today she has reached 9 kg. With a personalized diet, personalized therapy, and the right attention that a dog with IBD deserves, she is back to living, playing, and is as energetic as ever. But above all, she loves going to the clinic, to Dr. Zibellini, she loves him madly because he always gives her treats.
A wonderful person, who truly loves animals.
I truly recommend him to anyone who wants to have their furry friend treated; he is attentive and truly qualified, in every need, with a happy ending.
Thank you so much for meeting a person like you, and thank you so much for saving our beloved Vittoria, only 3 years old.

The vets seem very competent, but it's a shame about the receptionists, who, besides being particularly rude, are undoubtedly dishonest. Today I sent my dog ​​and my little sister (because I was at work) for some tests, and I had a quote of €230. Unfortunately, they didn't do any of the scheduled tests, only some ancillary ones, taking advantage of her ignorance. So I paid more or less the same amount, and I still have to do those tests.
We're so happy to read your review! Our team works passionately to offer the best for every pet. Thank you for sharing your experience!
Top. Professionalism and reliability. Highly recommended.

Exactly 3 years ago, our beloved dog left us. Today, our thoughts turn even more to him and the last months of treatment.
Thanks to Dr. Rovati for what he did to find a solution to our Labrador's problems, while I still remember Dr. Zibellini's utter rudeness and cynicism!!!
I will never forget how he reacted when he had to give my dog ​​an IV because I disturbed him while he was eating during office hours.
I should start by saying that I had known the office for over 20 years because Dr. Rovati treated all my animals, while I always tried to avoid consulting Dr. Zibellini, who was also famous for the "strange" advice he gave about our animals during the COVID period on a Barbara D'Urso show...
From Pavia to Milan for my puppy, it's an excellent, cutting-edge clinic with many professionals, all competent, helpful, and kind. They love animals, which is not a given.

Everyone is great, helpful, and knowledgeable: it's important because our beloved furry friends don't speak, and symptoms need to be recognized quickly to administer the right treatments that can help them feel better and save their lives! Thank you so much.

My cat was brought here for surgery by another vet, without my consent and without sharing all the information.
The surgery was done very well, but it's a shame they limited themselves to that alone without even considering the cat's other health concerns (ear cleanliness checks first and foremost).
Well done, but I would have expected more.
We are happy to know that our efforts are appreciated and that you had a positive experience with us.
Thank you for your review! Our team works hard every day to provide the best service possible.

On September 1st 2025, I took my 16-year-old Persian cat Charlie to Dr. Alabano Bruno Rovati's Vet Clinic. He examined him because he wasn't feeling well. He had lost a lot of weight and couldn't stand up straight. Dr. Rovati immediately discovered that his health was due to a neurological problem. He had a stroke. Dr. Rovati prescribed 5 drops of cortisone for 7 days in the cat's food in the morning, followed by another treatment every other day for another 10 days. The cat recovered incredibly quickly, slept a lot, and ate 2 bags of Royal Canin food and dry food a day. Today, September 26th, he was taken for a check-up by Dr. Rovati, who miraculously cured him. Charlie thanks Dr. Rovati from the bottom of his heart for the affection and for the care and therapy with which Dr. Rovati saved his life. He has now recovered and is undergoing physical therapy, jumping from the floor to the bed and from the bed back to the floor. Before, he couldn't do these movements with his four legs and was always bent to his left side, unable to support his left front and back paws. The cat is 95% recovered, now walking well and standing well. I sincerely thank Dr. Rovati for his love and his fantastic treatment, which worked very well and saved my Persian cat. Gabriella Di Sant'Angelo
Terrible reception service. They don't respond to emails, they're rude. It's a shame because they're really excellent vets.

Every visit was handled with care and attention, making me feel Hachiko was in good hands. A serious, reliable clinic that knows how to put both animals and their owners at ease. Highly recommended! 🐾

I went to the clinic for an emergency on the recommendation of my vet, who was on vacation. They examined my cat very quickly and provided a complete diagnosis. Fair prices. Highly recommended.

Even though this was one of the most painful moments we've ever experienced, we are deeply grateful for the professionalism, humanity, and kindness with which we were cared for.

Our beloved cat has left us after years of loving care, but knowing we could count on such attentive and respectful people made all the difference. In every visit, in every phone call, we felt sincere care, not only for her, but also for us. It's rare to find someone who, beyond their expertise, puts their heart into their work.

We will never forget the kindness with which she was treated until the last moment. In such a difficult time, we felt supported and understood.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for everything you did—and for how you did it.

- Would we really have done our best?

- Why didn't they urgently hospitalize a serious case?
